name: form-outline
title: Form outline
description: The jump list of a long form: each section with Done, Needs attention or Not started in shape and text, the one in view marked as you scroll.
docs: sections is the list: each has an id (the id of an element on the page), a label, a status (done, attention or todo) and, for attention, an errorCount that is written as "2 problems". By default the outline follows the scroll, in the page or in whatever scrolling container holds the sections, and marks the section in view with aria-current="location"; pass activeId to decide it yourself, or defaultActiveId to choose where it starts. Following a link scrolls the section to scrollOffset px under the top of the view (smoothly, at once under reduced motion) and moves focus to its first heading, which is made focusable by script; onNavigate receives the id first. sticky (default true) keeps the list in the side column, at lg:top-6 which className can change, and on a phone pins the compact bar to the top, where its own height is added to scrollOffset. The bar says "Section 3 of 6", shows the problem count of the current section and opens the list as a panel; Escape or a press outside closes it. A thin Progress counts the sections done. The nav is a landmark labelled "Form sections" (label), and labels renames every word.
